t: You're at Islamia Primary School, a voluntary aided Islamic faith school in Queen's Park, in the London Borough of Brent. It was founded by Yusuf Islam, better known to many as the singer-songwriter Cat Stevens. His musical career took in folk, rock and pop, and later Islamic music. He has also received awards for promoting peace and for humanitarian work. Here, his name is attached to something quite different from a record: a school.
